claims.subject: income_threshold
claims.statement: A household must have a combined annual income below $90,000 to be eligible.
claims.quote: To be eligible, a household must have a combined annual income below $90,000.

claims.subject: eligible_tenure
claims.statement: Only owner-occupiers can apply; renters are not eligible.
claims.quote: Only owner-occupiers can apply, so the grant is not open to people who rent the home they live in.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: The home must be the household's main residence and inside the declared disaster area.
claims.quote: The home must be the household's main residence and must be inside the declared disaster area.

claims.subject: other
claims.statement: The grant amount depends on the level of damage, assessed by the department after the application is lodged.
claims.quote: The amount depends on the level of damage, which is assessed by the department after the application is lodged.
